rows.ARS:
Medium yellow Floribunda.
Registration name: HARlightly
Exhibition name: Princess Michael of Kent ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Harkness & Co. (United Kingdom, before 1977).
Introduced in United Kingdom by R Harkness & Co. Ltd. in 1981 as 'Princess Michael of Kent'.
rows.Bloom: Yellow. Strong fragrance. 38 petals. Large, full (26-40 petals), borne mostly solitary, cluster-flowered, in small clusters, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Medium, bushy. Medium, semi-glossy, medium green foliage.

Height: 18" to 3' (45 to 90cm). Width: 18" to 3' (45 to 90cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b and warmer. Can be used for beds and borders, container rose, cut flower or garden. Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
rows.Notes: Princess Michael of Kent was removed from the Auckland Regional Botanic Gardens (ARBG) Display Trial because its trial period expired.
